newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-West Indies 89 for one at close v Australia.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-West Indies 89 for one at close v Australia.

text.p: West Indies, chasing 420 to win, were 89 for one at stumps on the fourth day of the first test against Australia on Monday.
Opener Sherwin Campbell was 28 not out and Brian Lara was unbeaten on 29.

Leg-spinner Shane Warne took the only West Indies wicket to fall, that of opener Robert Samuels for 29. Samuels was caught by Australia captain Mark Taylor at first slip after being dropped in the outfield by Paul Reiffel earlier in the same over.
Warne had 1-34 from 10 overs at the close.
Taylor earlier declared Australia's second innings closed at 217 for six, with Ian Healy 45 not out after Mark Waugh top-scored with 57.
